snippet.title: Jupiter Junkworks - Official Gameplay Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Jupiter Junkworks, a fast-paced arcade puzzle action game developed by Pixel Drake. Players will complete contracts to earn resources and rebuild a run-down spaceship junkyard. Dive into a sci-fi narrative campaign where an unlikely trio of travelers must learn to work together. But unknown to them, something awaits beyond the vault. Jupiter Junkworks is coming soon to PC (Steam).
